tips.text: Hit the daily cap with mission affinity first, then run all three Red Veil Syndicate Alerts and turn in every medallion, which ignore the cap.
Cap the day fast in Elite Sanctuary Onslaught, leaving around round 8, or in the Duviri Circuit past stage 4.
Run a Sedna Adaro Exterminate with Equinox, Ivara or Banshee to cap in one or two runs.
Run an Affinity Booster while capping; it roughly doubles the standing from affinity but not from medallions.
Rank up before your next mission or medallion turn-in; standing past a rank's maximum is lost.
Pledge Red Veil directly to climb fastest, or pledge Steel Meridian instead to keep Suda and Hexis and let Red Veil climb at half rate.
Bank standing with Cephalon Suda or Arbiters of Hexis first if you hold a high rank there; Red Veil gains drain them.
Players describe the climb as about a week of passive play at a high cap, two or three weeks at a lower Mastery Rank.
